source_agreement.note: sha256 of files ON DISK (did the tree move under the cell, not what bytecode executed). Case 1 runner_child_mismatch -> TornTree before running; case 2 moved_after_import -> WARNING, cell kept (an imported module is cached, the change did not execute); case 3 torn_lazy_import -> INVALID. Bounds: a file changed and changed back within a cell is invisible; runner-only files are outside case 1 and are covered by the runner's pre-flight refusal instead (disjoint halves, keep both); repo files only.

score.on_time_rule: an answer is delivered at COMPLETION, prefill plus decode (D146, the default from 2026-11-20); a dashcam Yes/No stays at first token

calibration.label: FINAL
calibration.application: D105: each clip is scored with the map from the folds that EXCLUDE it, the fold assignment taken from the calibration file

history_preload.rule: D101: each robot joins its FIRST session at a seeded point drawn uniformly in [0, 0.5 x session duration); questions before the join point are not emitted and not counted; at t = 0 a history_preload declares the frames the cloud already holds, with NO uplink time charged; later sessions in the chain start from zero (D83). Dashcam devices keep the run-time stagger and the complete-play rule (D85).
history_preload.note: D101: questions before a join point are not emitted and not counted, so the robot pool of a run under D101 is NOT the pool the pre-D101 traces produced; the D97 entry points were recomputed from traces for this reason.

score.targets_are_inputs: D71: targets are INPUTS. Every setting in the sweep is reported. The scorer never selects one.
caveats: D85: dashcam task value is streaming AP over the clip-PLAYS completed in the run, indexed by play id and paired across arms. It is NOT comparable to the committed 300-clip AP. D84: repeated clips or sessions across devices are separate plays and are NOT independent samples.

D87: robot device answers are the 4B-I x RECENT set of StudyO-Q4 (845 questions, 32.78 %), restricted to EVAL. They were produced by the 4B on the A6000 / H100, NOT on the Orin. StudyD15 Part A rejected the H100-for-Orin proxy as an exact numerical stand-in, so these answers are valid for ordering and first-order value, not as exact device numbers.

D70: the wire format is JPEG. S-EMBER q88 parity is NOT proven within the pre-registered +/- 2 pp rule (K3 +0.83 pp [-0.24, +2.01], K1 -0.6 pp with lower bound -2.14, about 6 % of letters change). S-EMBER cloud accuracy here is the cloud's actual answers on JPEG input.

D81: vLLM's prefix-cache path is not output-identical to recompute (StudyORIN3 Part 2: first-token drift p50 0.22, max 0.45 nats; 39 / 40 answers agree). Robot accuracy is reported split WARM / COLD from the request log's cache_path.

decision_period.rule: D99: one fixed 100-ms decision period for every arm, events batched per period, separate from H; a cap K on full DeltaJ evaluations per period is reported as a setting if one was used; the coordinator's own latency is counted and reported, never netted out

decisions.predicted_vs_actual_note: D63: the joiner that pairs these predictions with the measured outcomes is the coordinator session's; where it is absent the rows are carried through unjoined

diagnostics.cache_path_caveat: D81: vLLM's prefix-cache path is not output-identical to recompute (StudyORIN3 Part 2: first-token drift p50 0.22, max 0.45 nats; 39 / 40 answers agree). Robot accuracy is reported split WARM / COLD from the request log's cache_path.

device_delivery_rule.meaning: orin_rec_warm: StudyORIN-REC's MEASURED WARM per-question device COMPLETION latency on the 97 LH-REQ questions (Jetson AGX Orin, qwen3vl4b under vLLM, commit 00a223d). WARM PATH: the exact RECENT frames are prefilled first and cached_tokens covers them on all 97, so it is not comparable to a cold prefill curve.
device_delivery_rule.excluded: D155 (1): the LH-REQ device answer latencies, end-to-end median 3.354 s of which 3.296 s is TTFT (D155a corrects the earlier 6.651 s, which had added TTFT to an end-to-end figure that already contained it), are the COLD RE-SEND path, which D61 (b) classifies as an API artifact and not the device baseline. Not used here.
device_delivery_rule.answer_length: D146 (1) / P20: a robot answer is 2 OUTPUT TOKENS (completion_tokens == 2 on all 97 measured questions), so the 512-token answer cap is not the device's latency lever and a 0.270 s completion is almost entirely prefill plus fixed overhead.

cascade_device_wait.measured_warm_source: StudyORIN-REC warm p50 (commit 00a223d), per question where keyed
cascade_device_wait.label: proxy-0.567
cascade_device_wait.register: the live cascade wait is a RERUN item, not a re-score: it changes when the arm may act. Until coordinator.py adopts the measured value every cascade cell is labelled proxy-0.567 per D154 (5), whatever the scorer's device latency source is. The scorer's own device-answer arrival IS on the measured table.
cascade_device_wait.superseded: data_sources.DEVICE_WAIT_RULE_S = 0.567 is kept and labelled superseded; it is write-only (one reference, its own declaration) and is not what these arms pay

robot_headline.definition: D155 (3): the cloud's answer when it is delivered within the deadline, otherwise the DEVICE's answer IF THE DEVICE'S ANSWER ALSO ARRIVES WITHIN THE DEADLINE, otherwise no answer and the question is a miss; each answer scored on the representation actually sent

beside_it_any_time.definition: D152 (1), reported beside the headline and never mixed with it: the cloud's answer when it is delivered within the deadline, otherwise the device's answer REGARDLESS OF WHEN IT LANDS

dashcam_value.caveat: D85: dashcam task value is streaming AP over the clip-PLAYS completed in the run, indexed by play id and paired across arms. It is NOT comparable to the committed 300-clip AP. D84: repeated clips or sessions across devices are separate plays and are NOT independent samples.

by_deadline.rule: a device answer counts only if it arrived by the 2.0 s single-shot deadline. refspatial device completion is p50 1.9947 s against that deadline and 126 of 1,042 measured single-shot questions exceed it, all of them refspatial (45.5 percent of that dataset); realworldqa has none.

assistive_value.metrics_not_comparable: refspatial point_accuracy and realworldqa exact_match are DIFFERENT metrics and are never averaged together here
assistive_value.cloud_side_unscored: the cloud's SS answers are recorded but NOT scored in this function; scoring them needs each benchmark's own scorer from experiments/casestudy/ss2_kit.py. standing_accuracy over cloud-served opportunities is therefore absent, not zero.

metrics_health.why: state 'never_scraped': the engine-metric quantities listed in untrusted_quantities are NOT observations of the engine in this cell and must not be reported as though a zero among them were a policy outcome

proof_load_d209.twin_note: the twin is the committed 16-device 3 s 1x cell of the same arm and seed (for covex-v6-base / covex-v6-rules it is that arm under its committed name, hybrid-F-lhreq-noc3 / v5-rules-2, per arm_names_v6.OLD_TO_RUNG), so for a 0.25x, 2.5 s or 12/20-device cell the p99 ratio also carries the condition; only a cell with proof_ran = true is reported
proof_load_d209.rule: D209 user ruling 2026-11-23 option 2: proofs unpinned, nice 19, <= 2, never across a boundary
